scope: Additive TH18 Ruin Witch and required Ruin Knight mechanics contract. Official qualitative behavior and the August balance correction are preserved, but neither actor is materialized until deterministic rubble, movement and spawn rules are publicly reproducible.
game_version: The official June 2026 release describes the original Ruin Witch cycle. The official 30 August 2026 update removes Ruin Knight health decay and raises the summon cap from eight to ten; neither article identifies a client build or a fixed-tick lifecycle.

sources.title: The Anime Fury Update is Here
sources.limitations: Defines rubble selection, the 4-second work phase, 2-second summoning window, post-spawn animation, original eight-Knight cap, wall and visibility exclusions, retargeting, no-offense-attack rule, matching Knight level and nearest-building target. It does not publish Ruin Witch movement speed, rubble footprint/occupancy, arrival range, spawn coordinate, first-target timing, same-tick ordering, collision or fixed-tick pathing.

sources.title: August Update
sources.limitations: Changes only two published lifecycle values: Ruin Knights no longer lose health over time and Ruin Witch summons up to ten Knights. It does not specify effective tick, migration of existing Knights, spawn timing or any geometry.

sources.title: Ruin Witch CoC 2026 – Stats, Ruin Knight & Strategy Guide
sources.version: current page, client build not published
sources.limitations: Reports the four-level Knight HP, damage, 3× Wall damage, range, one-second cadence and movement-speed table used by the pinned observation. The page still presents pre-August cap/decay prose and offers no replay trace, coordinates, fixed-tick timing or collision contract.

missing: rubble representation, lifetime, footprint and reach distance
same-tick ordering for destruction, retarget, parent defeat, spawn and despawn
collision dimensions and verified visual assets

partial_mechanics_contract.note: The June source supplies the cycle; the August source supersedes its cap from 8 to 10. This is a data-only mechanics record, not an authorization for a guessed rubble actor.
The August source removes the former secondary 80 HP/s decay. The Knight cannot be materialized independently because it is non-deployable and its parent spawn contract remains incomplete.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only parent with original and revised source facts distributed across frozen observations and revisions.
changed_values.replacement: A dated, hash-pinned partial mechanics contract combines the official June cycle with the official August ten-Knight cap and explicitly blocks Core materialization on missing deterministic geometry and ordering.
changed_values.justification: The known timing values alone do not define a repeatable actor without rubble geometry, movement and spawn state.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only non-deployable child with a pinned secondary stat table and a frozen official decay correction.
changed_values.replacement: A dated, hash-pinned partial mechanics contract records its zero-decay post-August state and required parent dependency without creating a generic deployable proxy.
changed_values.justification: The official source identifies the child role but does not provide a deterministic spawn or lifecycle contract.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source publishes Ruin Witch movement speed, rubble tile coordinates, rubble lifetime, target arrival range, collision footprint, target tie-break, retarget scheduling, spawn offset/facing, or exact order when rubble destruction, parent defeat, cap completion and a summoning deadline share a rule tick.

No consulted source publishes a reproducible Ruin Knight spawn position, first acquisition delay, target/range tie-break, wall-versus-building path rule, collision footprint, despawn state, snapshot/replay lifecycle or source-verified visual geometry.

The dated secondary Knight table remains suitable for inventory data but has no client build and retains pre-August prose for the cap and decay; official August values take precedence only where explicitly stated.
conclusion: Ruin Witch L1-L4 and required Ruin Knight L1-L4 remain catalogued-only. The official 4-second work, 2-second summoning and 2-second follow-through values, the post-defeat spawn guarantee, ten-Knight cap and zero decay are all preserved with provenance. Core, Headless, Viewer, RL, snapshot and replay behaviors remain intentionally absent until deterministic geometry and lifecycle evidence exists.
